note: One file for the intervals, paired differences and summary tables quoted in the manuscript. Interval protocol (2000 percentile draws, seed 42). Intervals are conditional on the dates and campaigns that were observed; they do not describe new dates, seasons or sites. Gaocheng 40 m blocks resampled with replacement inside each date; Knezha the field units resampled with replacement, each with all its ESUs and campaigns. Paired differences reuse the same draws for both methods. Sections gaocheng_designs RMSE and within-date agreement of every method and design (script 43), with R2 and bias gaocheng_paired ensemble minus references (script 43); grouped-vs-LODO and forward-vs-LODO absolute-error gaps recomputed with the same date-stratified blocks knezha_designs zero-shot and within-Knezha designs with field-unit intervals transfer every scenario, model and feature set in both directions, on all target plots and on the stage-matched subset transfer_paired paired RMSE differences between transfer scenarios and source means field_levels within-campaign, between-field and within-field agreement at Knezha variance sequential sums of squares and moment (ANOVA) estimates calibration limited-label calibration summaries (script 44, per-group arrays dropped) mode_a leave-one-group-out check of releasing the uncalibrated map lai_anchors forward LAI standardisation anchors and their sensitivity Run after 41-45.

protocol.gaocheng: 40 m blocks resampled with replacement within each date
protocol.knezha: field units resampled with replacement with all their ESUs and campaigns
protocol.interpretation: conditional on the observed dates and campaigns

lai_anchors.rule: Fixed anchors replace the LAI target scaler only when the training dates hold fewer than 8 independent LAI labels (the first forward step, trained on 31 March); median and IQR are those of the anchor pair.
